# Writer's Digest

> Writer's Digest is the premier resource for writers of all levels, offering craft instruction, publishing guidance, competitions, and community across fiction, nonfiction, and poetry.

Writer's Digest provides comprehensive writing education through hubs dedicated to different genres and forms, alongside practical publishing resources, author interviews, writing prompts, and annual competitions. The site serves as a central hub for writers seeking to improve their craft, get published, and connect with the literary community.

## Key Topics

- creative writing
- fiction writing
- poetry writing
- nonfiction writing
- writing craft
- character development
- writing prompts
- poetry prompts
- literary agents
- getting published
- self-publishing
- memoir publishing
- author interviews
- writing resources
- publishing guide

## Writing Hubs by Genre

- [Write Better Fiction](https://www.writersdigest.com/write-better-fiction): Fiction writing hub covering character development, dialogue, plot, grammar, and techniques.
- [Write Better Nonfiction](https://www.writersdigest.com/write-better-nonfiction): Nonfiction writing hub covering articles, memoirs, creative nonfiction, and journalism.
- [Write Better Poetry](https://www.writersdigest.com/write-better-poetry): Poetry writing hub with prompts, poetic forms, poet interviews, and Poem-A-Day challenges.

## Publishing & Career

- [Getting Published](https://www.writersdigest.com/getting-published): Publishing guide covering literary agents, query writing, platform building, and submissions.
- [Business of Writing Archives](https://www.writersdigest.com/getting-published/business-of-writing): Archive of articles on publishing business, author career, and writing entrepreneurship.
- [Marketing Archives](https://www.writersdigest.com/getting-published/build-my-platform/marketing): Author marketing and platform-building strategies, book promotion, and visibility tips.

## Community & Inspiration

- [Be Inspired](https://www.writersdigest.com/be-inspired): Inspiration hub with writing prompts, author interviews, quotes, and book recommendations.
- [WD Events](https://www.writersdigest.com/wd-events): Writer's Digest conferences, writing retreats, and workshops featuring industry experts.
- [WD Competitions](https://www.writersdigest.com/wd-competitions): Writer's Digest annual writing competitions across poetry, essays, and self-published books.

## Writing Guides & Archives

- [Wednesday Poetry Prompts Archives](https://www.writersdigest.com/write-better-poetry/poetry-prompts/wednesday-poetry-prompts): Archive of weekly poetry prompts and writing exercises by Robert Lee Brewer.
- [Articles Archives](https://www.writersdigest.com/write-better-nonfiction/articles): Archive of nonfiction article writing guides, journalism tips, and essay techniques.
- [Horror Archives](https://www.writersdigest.com/write-better-fiction/genre/horror): Horror writing guide with craft tips, author interviews, and genre-specific techniques.
- [Resources Archives](https://www.writersdigest.com/resources): Archive of writing guides, podcasts, screenwriting, and author resources.

## Featured Articles & Interviews

- [What 19 Years Taught Me About Publishing a Memoir](https://www.writersdigest.com/what-19-years-taught-me-about-publishing-a-memoir): Alexandra Grabbe shares eight memoir publishing lessons learned over 19 years.
- [Karma Brown: Writing What You Know is Boring](https://www.writersdigest.com/karma-brown-writing-what-you-know-is-boring): Author Karma Brown interview discussing her psychological thriller novel and craft.
- [8 Tips for Writing Military History Articles](https://www.writersdigest.com/8-tips-for-writing-military-history-articles): Matthew Adams shares eight tips for writing military history articles professionally.
- [Media-Savvy Author: Keeping Media Momentum Beyond the Book Launch](https://www.writersdigest.com/media-savvy-author-keeping-media-momentum-beyond-the-book-launch): Paula Rizzo explains post-launch book marketing strategies and reader engagement plans.

- [Writer's Digest March/April 2026 Cover Reveal](https://www.writersdigest.com/writers-digest-march-april-2026-cover-reveal): Magazine cover reveal featuring Lauren Groff interview and pacing craft article.
